item.tib: 'phags pa'i gnas brten gyi mchod pa mdo sde me tog 'phreng ba
item.coloph: de nas phyi rab g.yung drung sems dpa'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa g.yung drung sems dpa'i rjes zhugs gang zag bla med bsgrub pa'i phyir du/ mdo gam zab mo yi sgang rgyud/ rngul rdza gnyis kyi bar mtshams nas bod glang spe ne ri bkra'i g.yon phyogs/ sum pa glang gi gyim shod/ rta yi za ma ri rgyud kyi grub gnas/ gnas mchog shel le rdzong drug gi yang rtse/ mngon par dga'i sgrub phug tu me lug zla tshes bzang por mdo sde zab mo gtan la phab pas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas gyur cig/
